name: detectai-document-parser (loadtest)
description: Load-test view for document-parser (deployment.environment = loadtest): k6-driven throughput/latency plus host and collector infra. service.name = document-parser.

pages.name: Document parser load test
pages.description: App RED under load plus host/collector saturation

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `uploads/min` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server' AND http.route = '/api/v1/extract'
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server' AND http.route = '/api/v1/extract'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 99) AS `p99 ms` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server' AND http.route = '/api/v1/extract'

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server' AND http.route = '/api/v1/extract' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND name = 'extraction' AND `mime.type` = 'application/pdf' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND name = 'extraction' AND `mime.type` = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND name = 'extraction' AND `mime.type` = 'text/plain' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(parsed_documents_total), 1 minute)*average(extraction_duration_seconds)/max(extraction_pool_max_workers)*100 AS `pool utilization %` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Metric SELECT average(extraction_pool_queue_depth) AS `queue depth`, average(in_flight_requests) AS `in-flight` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES 1 minute

FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS `readiness 503s` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server' AND `http.status_code` = '503' AND (http.route = '/api/v1/ready' OR http.route = '/api/v1/health') TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT average(extraction_queue_wait_seconds) AS `wait s` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET cases(WHERE mime_type = 'text/plain' AS 'txt', WHERE mime_type = 'application/pdf' AS 'pdf', WHERE mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' AS 'docx') TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Metric SELECT sum(extraction_failures_total) AS failures WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET error_type TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(rejected_uploads_total), 1 minute) AS `rejections/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET reason TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(extraction_timeouts_total), 1 minute) AS `timeouts/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET cases(WHERE mime_type = 'text/plain' AS 'txt', WHERE mime_type = 'application/pdf' AS 'pdf', WHERE mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' AS 'docx') TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server' FACET `http.status_code` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Metric SELECT sum(extraction_timeouts_total) AS timeouts WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest'
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`container.cpu.utilization`) AS `cpu %` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%document-parser%'
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`container.memory.percent`) AS `mem %` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%document-parser%'
FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.cpu.utilization`) AS `cpu` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%document-parser%' TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.memory.percent`) AS `mem` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%document-parser%' TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`container.network.io.usage.rx_bytes`), 1 minute) AS rx WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%document-parser%' TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`container.network.io.usage.tx_bytes`), 1 minute) AS tx WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%document-parser%' TIMESERIES 1 minute

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`container.cpu.throttling_data.throttled_time`), 1 minute) AS `throttled ns/s` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%document-parser%' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT max(duration.ms) AS `max ms`, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms`, count(*) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND name = 'extraction' FACET cases(WHERE `mime.type` LIKE '%pdf%' AS 'pdf', WHERE `mime.type` LIKE '%officedocument%' AS 'docx', WHERE `mime.type` LIKE '%plain%' AS 'txt') LIMIT 20
FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS spans FACET service.name, service.version WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service.name = 'document-parser' LIMIT 20

pages.name: Logs
pages.description: Error-first log stream plus volume and slow requests under load

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT timestamp, `severity.text`, message, path, status_code, `trace.id` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `severity.text` = 'ERROR' LIMIT 100

widgets.title: Log volume by level (click legend to isolate) (load)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET `severity.text` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `severity.text` = 'ERROR' FACET path TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n, latest(message) AS sample, latest(`trace.id`) AS `sample trace` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `severity.text` = 'ERROR' FACET path LIMIT 20
FROM Log SELECT timestamp, message, path, duration_ms, status_code, `trace.id` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND duration_ms > 1500 LIMIT 100
